# Laurence

## Overview

- **Gender:** male (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
- **Role:** sailor (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P12](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

Laurence Vane possesses a striking physical likeness to [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md). Additionally, he has a distinct ocular trait consisting of one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## Personality

Laurence is known for his playful nature and fondness for pranks. Despite this mischievous streak, he is a genuinely pleasant individual.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_
